id: 50_How is Biorisk management audited or evaluated biorisk management biosafety tren
title: 生物风险管理，怎么检查好不好
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/50_How is Biorisk management audited or evaluated biorisk management biosafety tren.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/50_How is Biorisk management audited or evaluated biorisk management biosafety tren/src.py

points.K2: 审核评价：管理有没有效
points.S1: 日常自查：自己先查自己

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一个大放大镜，对着镜头眨眼
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a big magnifying glass and winks at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全措施做了，到底管不管用？
overlay: 生物风险管理，怎么检查好不好

shots.scene: 五个空白格子依次亮起，每格一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: Five blank boxes light up one by one, each with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 今天讲五种检查和评价的办法。

shots.scene: 王老师在走廊上通知：下周学院来检查，小研拿着空白通知单
shots.prompt_en: In the corridor the safety administrator announces an upcoming inspection; the female graduate student holds a blank notice.
shots.narration: 学院下周要来做安全检查。

shots.scene: 阿杰慌忙把台面上的杂物往柜子里塞
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hurriedly stuffs clutter from the bench into a cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰慌了：赶紧把东西藏起来！

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研说：检查是帮我们找问题的。

shots.scene: 五个圆形图标围成一圈，箭头首尾相连
shots.prompt_en: Five round icons form a circle connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 风险管理是一个五步的圆圈。

shots.scene: 放大镜图标、天平图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon and a scale icon light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 收集信息，评价风险。

shots.scene: 路线图图标、盾牌图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: A roadmap icon and a shield icon light up in turn. No people.
shots.narration: 制定策略，落实控制措施。

shots.scene: 循环箭头图标亮起，箭头回到起点
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon lights up and the arrow returns to the start. No people.
shots.narration: 最后复查，然后再转一圈。

shots.section_title: 审核评价：管理有没有效
shots.scene: 复查节点放大，里面出现一个检查表
shots.prompt_en: The review node enlarges and shows a blank checklist inside. No people.
shots.narration: 审核和评价，就是复查这一步。
overlay: 审核评价：管理有没有效

shots.section_title: 审核评价：管理有没有效
shots.scene: 天平一边是规程，一边是实际操作的手
shots.prompt_en: A balance with a procedure sheet on one side and a working hand on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 看写的和做的，是否一致。

shots.scene: 老周和小研拿着空白检查表，逐项查看本实验室
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student walk through their own lab with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第一种：内部审核。

shots.scene: 检查表一边是规程图标，一边是安全柜、利器盒、记录本
shots.prompt_en: A checklist with a procedure icon on one side and a biosafety cabinet, a sharps container and a logbook on the other. No people.
shots.narration: 由本单位组织，对照规程逐项查。

shots.scene: 学院、学校两层的人形图标带着检查表走进实验室
shots.prompt_en: Department and university icons with checklists enter a lab icon. No people.
shots.narration: 学院、学校也会定期组织检查。

shots.scene: 检查表上记下发现，旁边签名和日期
shots.prompt_en: Findings are written on the checklist with a signature and date. No people.
shots.narration: 查到什么，如实记下来。

shots.scene: 一个外来检查组图标，带着印章走向实验室
shots.prompt_en: An external inspection team icon carrying a stamp walks toward a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 第二种：外部审核和检查。

shots.scene: 政府建筑图标和印章
shots.prompt_en: A government building icon and an official stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 主管部门会依法监督检查。

shots.scene: 高级别实验室门图标旁出现认可证书图标
shots.prompt_en: A high-level lab door icon next to an accreditation certificate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 高级别实验室，还要通过国家认可。

shots.scene: 王老师陪同检查组，老周介绍情况
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator accompanies an inspection; the older man explains the lab setup.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人陪同，配合检查。

shots.scene: 仪表盘上三根指针，各配一个图标
shots.prompt_en: A dashboard with three gauges, each with an icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三种：用绩效指标来衡量。

shots.scene: 事件报告单图标，数字增减的柱状图
shots.prompt_en: An incident report icon and a simple bar chart going up and down. No people.
shots.narration: 看事件报告：发生了多少，什么原因。

shots.scene: 差点打翻的培养瓶被及时扶住的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a culture flask nearly tipping over and being caught in time. No people.
shots.narration: 看险兆事件：差一点出事的也算。

shots.scene: 培训名单上逐个打勾，进度条走到满格
shots.prompt_en: A training roster gets checked name by name and a progress bar fills up. No people.
shots.narration: 看培训：该学的人是否都学完。

shots.scene: 检查表上一个红叉，箭头指向扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A red cross on the checklist with an arrow pointing to a wrench icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四种：发现问题，纠正措施。

shots.scene: 一张空白整改单，三栏：人、工具、日历
shots.prompt_en: A blank corrective action form with three columns: a person, a tool, a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 谁来改，怎么改，什么时候改完。

shots.scene: 老李更换安全柜旁破损的利器盒，小研拍照记录
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer replaces a damaged sharps container while the female graduate student takes a photo for the record.
shots.narration: 改完拍照留证，再复查。

shots.scene: 红叉变成绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: The red cross turns into a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 问题关闭，才算整改到位。

shots.scene: 一级一级向上的台阶，每级一个对勾
shots.prompt_en: A staircase going up step by step, each step with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第五种：持续改进。

shots.scene: 审核报告和事件报告两条箭头汇入一本规程
shots.prompt_en: Arrows from an audit report and an incident report flow into a procedure booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 把检查和事件的教训，写进规程。

shots.scene: 循环图又转了一圈，螺旋上升
shots.prompt_en: The circular diagram turns again and rises like a spiral. No people.
shots.narration: 一圈一圈，越做越好。

shots.section_title: 日常自查：自己先查自己
shots.scene: 小研开工前看安全柜指示灯，收工后看台面
shots.prompt_en: Before work the female graduate student checks the cabinet indicator; after work she checks the bench.
shots.narration: 等别人来查，不如自己先查。
overlay: 日常自查：自己先查自己

shots.section_title: 日常自查：自己先查自己
shots.scene: 墙上贴着空白自查表，每天一格打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank self-check sheet on the wall gets a tick in a new box each day. No people.
shots.narration: 每天开工收工，看一眼自查表。

shots.section_title: 日常自查：自己先查自己
shots.scene: 阿杰发现利器盒快满了，主动更换
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices the sharps container is nearly full and replaces it.
shots.narration: 发现小问题，当场就处理。

shots.scene: 检查前一晚突击把杂物藏起来的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of hiding clutter the night before an inspection, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 检查前突击藏东西，不可取。

shots.scene: 补签、补写记录的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of back-filling and back-signing old records, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 记录不补签，不造假。

shots.scene: 小研把平时的样子展示给王老师，指出一处不足
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows the lab as it really is to the safety administrator and points out a weak spot.
shots.narration: 平时什么样，检查就什么样。

shots.scene: 阿杰在组会上举手发言，老周点头
shots.prompt_en: At a group meeting the young male student raises his hand to speak and the older man nods.
shots.narration: 学生也能提改进建议。

shots.scene: 意见箱图标，几张空白便签投进去
shots.prompt_en: A suggestion box icon with blank notes being dropped in. No people.
shots.narration: 规程哪里不好用，大胆说。

shots.scene: 规程版本号从旧到新，更新后发给全组
shots.prompt_en: A procedure booklet is updated to a new version and handed to everyone in the group. No people.
shots.narration: 好建议采纳了，规程就更新。

shots.scene: 检查当天，王老师在检查表上打勾，小研陪同
shots.prompt_en: On inspection day the safety administrator ticks a checklist while the female graduate student accompanies.
shots.narration: 检查那天，小研如实介绍情况。

shots.scene: 阿杰接过整改单，认真点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student receives a corrective action form and nods seriously.
shots.narration: 查出两个问题，限期整改。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前，五个格子依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard where five boxes light up one by one.
shots.narration: 内部审核、外部检查、看指标。

shots.scene: 后两个格子亮起：扳手和上升台阶
shots.prompt_en: Two more boxes light up with a wrench and a rising staircase.
shots.narration: 发现问题就纠正，持续改进。

shots.scene: 小研、阿杰在自查表上签名
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student sign the self-check sheet.
shots.narration: 自己先查，如实迎检，人人献策。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds the magnifying glass and waves goodbye to the camera.
shots.narration: 检查是为了更安全，再见！
